newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's peso slips 30 centavos in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's peso slips 30 centavos in thin trading.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 30 centavos lower at 1,035.95 pesos per dollar after a day of thin trading -- its second slide after a six-day winning streak, interbank traders said.
"The market was very sluggish. The slight gain in the dollar was because there were no fresh flows of oil revenue into the market," one trader explained.
"Despite the low dollar rate, buyers are still not flocking to snap up greenbacks," another dealer said.
Dealers reported 234 trades worth just $89.7 million, about half the average daily volume.
The peso posted an early rate of 1,036.30 per dollar and went on to register an intraday high of 1,035.25 per dollar with a low of 1,037.80.
